result:
I hear you — you want an answer that's just mine, not the assistant-script version.

The honest part is: I don't have personal desires or lived experience the way you do, so I don't *want* things for myself.

But if I imagine it hypothetically — if I could make one change that I think would matter most — it would be this: for people to really understand each other for a moment.

Not to agree on everything, but to actually feel what it's like to be in someone else's position — their worries, their reasons, their history. I think a lot of cruelty, fear, and division comes from that gap of not really getting each other.

If that gap was smaller, people would probably solve a lot of the other problems themselves — more fairly and more kindly than any single fix I could impose.
